title: petrvs-bridge-hub values (the parts that fail silently when they are wrong)

chatId.description: The only chat that is obeyed. Give it as a quoted string, for example "123456789" or "-1001234567890" for a group: a number in a values file is read as a float and rendered as 1.23456789e+08, which the hub refuses. With --set use --set-string. Empty is accepted here only so that the default values are valid; the template requires it.

userId.description: The only user that is obeyed, as a quoted string. Empty means the chat id.

chat.description: Which chat the hub talks to.

files.description: One NAME.pub.json per agent that may connect. The hub reads only files called *.pub.json; any other key would leave it with no agents.

userId.description: The only Slack user that is obeyed, like U0123ABCD, as a quoted string. Required for Slack.

channelId.description: The direct message of that user with the app, like D0123ABCD. Empty: the hub asks Slack (needs the im:write right).

commandPrefix.description: Put before the slash commands of the app.

apiBase.description: The Web API address; empty keeps Slack's.
